title: Feature Request: Allow user to choose if Nightscout upload uses noise smoothed or unprocessed data
body: My assumption is most people expect xDrip uploads to replicate the same data as displayed in the app. As per the gitter discussion, the uploads currently always use unprocessed data, while xDrip displays data smoothed for noise. I'd love the app to implement support for choosing what gets uploaded, where the default behavior would be for the uploads to match the xDrip display, with an optional override to upload smoothed/unprocessed data. This would be especially useful for households that rely on Nightscout for data display (mixed iOS / Android houses).
